subject.label: Subject
subject.why: Subject is '<Leave kind>, <begin>~<end>, <destination>, <name>' with dates only, also for hourly leave (no times): this is the shape the form's change handlers generate and every own doc (incl. HR-edited 299357) has; the repo's hourly template ('<date> 16:00~17:00') diverges from it.

leave_kind[].label: Leave Kind / Kind
leave_kind[].why: Kind of leave (Annual, Compensatory, Childcare, ...) is chosen per case from the remaining balances.

using_type[].label: Leave Kind / Using (Full day | Hours)
using_type[].why: Full day vs Hours is a fact of the case.

start_time[].label: Leave Kind / Hours (from)
start_time[].why: Hour of the case (hourly leave only).

end_time[].label: Leave Kind / Hours (to)
end_time[].why: Hour of the case (hourly leave only).

purpose.label: Purpose for leave
purpose.why: Content is per case (all own docs say 'child care', a habit not a rule); the only rule is that form text is English.

destination.label: Destination for leaves
destination.why: Where the user will be is a fact of the case (own docs: always home address, which is not a rule and is not listed); the only rule is that form text is English.
